$Comment: A Revenant Guardian (the Skeleton Elite) kill counts as a boss fight, attempted and won, for the
player who lands the killing blow: a quest step, a contract or an achievement counting boss fights
counts it, with Skeleton_Elite_Phase_2 as the target. The game runs this fight without a boss bar,
so the library keeps no run for it and this row is how it counts.
It names the second phase so each fight counts once: the game turns the first phase into
Skeleton_Elite_Phase_2 when its health drops below a fifth or its guard breaks, so the creature that
finally dies is always the second phase. A kill that takes the first phase from above a fifth of its
health to nothing in one blow skips the second phase and counts nothing.
Match.Role is the role id exactly, case ignored. The second phase has no name of its own, so
Switch it off with Enabled false, or from mods/ziggfreedcommon/encounter-rules.json under the key
skeleton_elite_phase_2, and the kill counts as a kill and nothing more.
